title: 10 Terribly Bungled Crimes
summary: Josh and Chuck discuss the HowStuffWorks article "10 Terribly Bungled Crimes." Chuck opens with a viral video of a would-be liquor store thief who falls through the ceiling, gets stuck, and sits smoking a cigarette until police arrive. They talk about big heists like the Lufthansa heist as contrast, and the hosts theorize that bungled crimes stem from laziness. They recount several stories: a Rochelle, Georgia woman who called police to recover money paid for fake crack; a Miami man who demanded a refund over a fast food order, brandished a weapon at the drive-through, and ran off with ketchup packets; a Phoenix bank robber who paid for cigarettes at a convenience store during a police chase; and an unverified Michigan drunk who called police on himself after demanding money from a convenience store. The episode closes with a Star Wars trivia question (answer: Lando Calrissian, played by Billy Dee Williams, as a Dr Pepper bottle in a one-man Star Wars trilogy video on HowStuffWorks) and sponsor reads for Visa and the camera.

segments.title: Opening banter and viral video
segments.summary: Hosts introduce the episode after a Visa sponsor tag; Chuck describes a viral video of a bungled liquor store burglary in which the thief falls through the ceiling, gets stuck, and smokes a cigarette until police arrive.

segments.title: Big heists versus bungled crimes
segments.summary: Hosts contrast the Lufthansa heist and a 2006 Great Britain heist with the smaller bungled crimes in the article, and theorize that criminals who bungle are lazy.

segments.title: Rochelle, Georgia crack purchase
segments.summary: A woman who stole crack cocaine thought it was not real, so she called police to help recover her money.

segments.title: Miami drive-through robbery
segments.summary: A man ordering fast food disputed the price, drove off, returned on foot with a weapon to demand money at the drive-through window, was refused, and ran off with a handful of ketchup packets.

segments.title: Phoenix bank robber buys cigarettes during chase
segments.summary: After robbing a bank in Phoenix, a suspect stopped at a convenience store during a police chase to buy cigarettes, paying with a twenty; he was caught with the pack unopened.

segments.title: Unverified Michigan robbery story
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh discuss a Michigan story about a drunk man who demanded money from a convenience store and then called police on himself; Josh notes he could not verify it with good sources.

segments.title: Star Wars trivia and sponsor reads
segments.summary: Hosts give the answer to a Star Wars trivia question (Lando Calrissian, played by Billy Dee Williams, appearing as a Dr Pepper bottle on HowStuffWorks video) and read Visa and camera sponsor messages.

segments.title: Sign-off
segments.summary: Hosts direct listeners to HowStuffWorks.com and the podcast email address and end the episode.
